title: Chapel Hymnal Redesign
description: A faithful, polished reinterpretation of the traditional hymnal — high production value paired with deep respect for the source material and its liturgical context.

title: Sunday School Zine
description: A photocopied, hand-lettered zine for youth ministry — rough and playful in execution, but still sincere and respectful toward its subject matter.

title: Sermon Meme Series
description: Fast, scrappy social posts that poke fun at sermon cliches. Low production, high irreverence — made to be shared, not archived.

title: Deconstructed Communion Set
description: A finely crafted, gallery-quality object that subverts expectations of communion ware — technically masterful, conceptually irreverent.

title: Prayer App Wireframes
description: Early-stage UX sketches for a daily prayer companion app. Sits near center — earnest in tone, moderate in polish.

title: Stained Glass Pattern Library
description: A rigorous vector library of stained glass motifs, built to exacting geometric standards for reuse across chapel signage, bulletins, and windows.

title: Youth Retreat Poster Series
description: Loud, xeroxed concert-style posters promoting the annual youth retreat — riso-printed, hand-cut lettering, made in an afternoon.

title: Liturgical Calendar App Icons
description: A flat, functional icon set marking feast days and liturgical seasons inside a calendar app — sincere in tone, quick to produce.

title: Deity Emoji Pack
description: A polished, professionally rendered sticker pack of cheeky religious-figure emoji — technically excellent, tone entirely tongue-in-cheek.
